# RoofWrap

> RoofWrap is residential disaster-response roof protection: the engineered alternative to a blue tarp. We install a 12 mil shrink-wrap roof membrane in hours to keep a home dry after storm, hail, wind, or fire damage, and while permanent roofs, tile, and slate are on order.

## What RoofWrap is
- A 12 mil shrink-wrap roof membrane, tensioned and heat-sealed into one continuous, watertight surface.
- Class-A fire rated (ASTM E84, zero flame spread), wind tested past 150 mph, rated for up to 24 months of UV exposure.
- Installed with zero roof penetrations. No nails through the decking, no sandbags.
- The stronger, cleaner, longer-lasting alternative to a blue tarp for homeowners.

## Better than a blue tarp
- Blue tarps are a 30 to 90 day product; RoofWrap is rated for up to 24 months.
- Blue tarps are nailed through the roof, adding holes and leaks; RoofWrap adds zero penetrations.
- Blue tarps tear and blow off in wind; RoofWrap is one continuous membrane wind tested past 150 mph.
- Blue tarps are flammable; RoofWrap is Class-A fire rated.

## Who it is for
- Homeowners nationwide after storm, hurricane, hail, wind, fire, or fallen-tree roof damage.
- Homes with tile, clay, Spanish, slate, or custom roofs facing long replacement lead times.
- Multifamily buildings, condos, townhomes, and HOAs.

## Tile, slate, and long-lead roofs
- Custom tile and slate often take months to source. RoofWrap keeps the home completely dry for the full lead time so owners never have to accept a mismatched substitute.

## Insurance
- Emergency roof protection is a standard mitigation expense on most homeowner policies. RoofWrap documents the damage and installation for the claim, and the membrane can be cut for inspection and re-sealed.
